Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## What's new

**Search from Home**
- One search bar finds events and any item inside them: item names, categories, notes and who paid. Hidden events are included and marked.
- Results are grouped into Events and Items with matches highlighted. Opening an item jumps to its event with the list already filtered to it.

**Hide events**
- Hide an event to remove its card from Home. It moves to a **Hidden events** folder at the bottom, where you can open or unhide it. Hiding only changes your own view.

**Push notifications**
- In-app notifications now also arrive as phone notifications, including when the app is closed. Tap one to open its event. Android 13+ asks for permission the first time.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.6.0.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
